title: Jagged Chicken Wrap
description: A delicious and spicy Vietnamese-inspired wrap with marinated chicken and crunchy jagged vegetables.

ingredients.name: jagged vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, cucumbers, and bell peppers

instructions: Marinate chicken in sweet chili sauce and fish sauce for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Cook chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Grill jagged vegetables for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
Warm wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble wrap by spreading a layer of marinated chicken on the wrap, followed by grilled jagged vegetables and chopped cilantro.
